join_path_requirements.name: leads_to_deals
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports leads without deals and lead-conversion analysis.

join_path_requirements.name: deals_to_leads
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports deal analysis using source-lead attributes.

join_path_requirements.name: products_to_quotations
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports product sales and quoted-price analysis.

join_path_requirements.name: deals_to_quotations_to_products
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports the required Deal-to-Product path through quotation lines.

join_path_requirements.name: leads_to_deals_to_quotations_to_products
join_path_requirements.join_condition: deals.lead_id = leads.lead_id AND quotations.deal_id = deals.deal_id AND quotations.product_id = products.product_id
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports the complete Lead-to-Deal-to-Product business path.

join_path_requirements.name: targets_to_won_deals
join_path_requirements.join_condition: deals.rep_name = targets.rep_name AND deals.close_date >= targets.period_start AND deals.close_date < targets.period_end AND deals.stage = 'Won'
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports targets with zero attained revenue.

join_path_requirements.name: won_deals_to_targets
join_path_requirements.join_condition: deals.rep_name = targets.rep_name AND deals.close_date >= targets.period_start AND deals.close_date < targets.period_end AND deals.stage = 'Won'
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports quota-attainment SUM calculations for won deals.

consistency_rules: Every deal must reference an existing lead, and that lead must have status Converted.
A deal must copy rep_name ownership from its source lead.
Leads without deals must remain present for the declared LEFT JOIN path.
Generated product SKU values must be unique even though SKU is not a SQL key.
Every quotation must reference an existing deal and product.
The quotation bridge must include at least one multi-product deal and one product used by multiple deals.
Quotation created_at must be on or before quoted_at.
Closed deals require close_date; open deals may have a null close_date.
Deal created_at, close_date, and expected_close_date must follow configured chronological rules.
Target periods for each representative must not overlap and use start-inclusive, end-exclusive boundaries.
Representative names and territories must align across leads, deals, and targets.
At least one target period must contain won deals and at least one must have zero attainment.
All deal, product, quotation-price, and target monetary values use USD.
Only quotations may gain rows during imperfection injection.
